subject: Multi-year commit — uplift cap & price-lock approval request
body:
From: Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@apexhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Redwood - Apex Health 3yr commitment

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited. We're close to a procurement/risk review sign-off but need a couple of commercial commitments before we proceed to PO:

- Price lock for the first 24 months of a 3-year committed term (we need predictability for budgeting).
- An uplift cap (max annual price increase) — requested 7% cap.
- Renewal protection clause that prevents unreasonable mid-contract increases and provides a 90-day notice plus right to terminate on material adverse pricing changes.

Attached is SOW_v3 with the proposed usage tiers. If Redwood can commit to these items plus the 3-year TCV structure, Procurement will move to an expedited review and issue a PO.

Can you confirm if this is something you can do and what approvals you need on your side?

Thanks,
Sarah Dunne
Head of Vendor Relations
Apex Health

Attachment: ApexHealth_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 245 KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Redwood - Apex Health 3yr commitment

Hi Sarah — great to hear, and appreciate the clear asks.

Quick summary for clarity:
- Apex requests: 3-year commitment, price lock for first 24 months, uplift cap 7% thereafter, 90-day notice + termination right on material pricing changes.
- Next steps on our side: route to Finance and Legal for lift/cost analysis and redlines. We may need an exec approval for a non-standard price-lock/uplift cap combo if it materially impacts our guardrails.

I'll route internally right now and circle back with recommended options and an approval ask.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: Redwood - Apex Health 3yr commitment — approval needed

Team — forwarding Apex Health's ask (attached SOW). Key points below and what I need:

Summary of ask (Apex):
- 3-year committed TCV (revenue profile in SOW).
- Price-lock: no price increases for first 24 months.
- Uplift cap: 7% max annual increase after lock period.
- Renewal protection: 90-day notice + termination right on material increases.

What I need from you:
- Vivek: cost/margin impact + recommended uplift cap / alternative concessions if 7% is too tight.
- Laura: high-level redline for renewal clause and any indemnity/termination implications.
- Rishi: input on commercial (discounts, go-to-market concessions, TCV tradeoffs).

Target: I'd like to reply to Apex with a recommended position by EOD 6 Mar so Procurement can move. If we need exec approval, could you flag it and I'll route to Evelyn.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachment (forward): ApexHealth_SOW_v3.pdf

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Redwood - Apex Health 3yr commitment — approval needed

Marissa — reviewed the numbers in the SOW. Quick take:

- Baseline: proposed 3-year TCV of $1.8M (yearly breakdown in attached sheet).
- If we accept a 24-month absolute price lock, our unit economics worsen in scenarios where model/infra costs rise; exposure concentrated in years 2–3.
- Uplift cap at 7% is tighter than our conservative guidance; recommend 8–10% cap or a cap tied to CPI (whichever is lower) to limit downside.
- Alternative: 24-month lock for the list prices on existing SKUs, but allow indexation on cloud pass-throughs and quantization/instance-type cost adjustments (explicit carve-outs).
- Concession we can consider to close: 12–15% up-front discount on year 1 in exchange for a 3-year committed minimum and quarterly usage minima.

Recommend: propose a compromise — price lock for first 12 months, then uplift cap set to 8% (or CPI, whichever is lower), with a carve-out for explicit hardware/cloud cost changes. Offer a 12% first-year discount as consideration. This reduces long-term exposure but keeps deal momentum.

Attachment: pricing_playbook.xlsx (Excel, 120 KB)

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Redwood - Apex Health 3yr commitment — approval needed

Team — attached redlines and high-level comments. Main points:

- Renewal protection: accept a 90-day notice requirement, but limit the remedy to the right to terminate if increase > X% (we should define X — legal prefers a numeric cap rather than subjective 'material').
- Proposed drafting: "For any Renewal, Redwood may not increase pricing by more than the lesser of (i) 8% per 12-month period and (ii) the CPI as published by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Customer shall receive no less than 90 days' written notice prior to any price change; if the increase exceeds the stated cap, Customer may terminate within 30 days of notice for convenience with pro rata refund for prepaid fees."
- Carve-outs: allow pass-through increases (e.g., third-party hosting price increases) if accompanied by documented evidence; require Customer to be given at least 60 days' notice for pass-throughs.
- Indemnities and termination: keep standard language; do not accept unlimited indemnity.

I redlined the SOW with the proposed clause and tracked changes. If Finance needs a lower numeric cap than 8%, we should reconcile now so we present a single counter.

Attachment: redlines_ApexHealth.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 16:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Redwood - Apex Health 3yr commitment — approval needed

All — consolidating the ask and recommending a path to close.

Commercial recommendation (one-line): offer a business-friendly but risk-mitigated package to keep the deal: 3-year commitment, price lock for year 1, uplift cap 8% thereafter (or CPI, whichever is lower), explicit cloud pass-through carve-out, and a 12% discount in year 1.

Why this works:
- Protects Redwood from unpredictable infra inflation while showing good-faith pricing predictability to the customer.
- Discount offsets the customer's ask for a 24-month lock.
- Keeps TCV and runway for upsell/expansion.

Terms requiring an exception / exec sign-off:
- Price-lock shorter than customer's requested 24 months (we're proposing 12 months).
- Uplift cap at 8% (below Finance's comfortable 10% ceiling but above customer request of 7%).

Ask for Evelyn: approve the exception to our standard pricing guardrails for this strategic account (managed care reference customer, good expansion potential). If approved, I'll send the counter to Apex + include the redline and DocuSign link.

Thanks — Rishi

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Redwood - Apex Health 3yr commitment — approval needed

Thanks team — I reviewed the summary and the attachments. I approve the following commercial package and exceptions:

Approved package (executive sign-off):
- 3-year commitment with list-price price lock for the first 12 months.
- Uplift cap of 8% per 12-month period after the 12-month lock, capped by CPI (i.e., the lesser of 8% or CPI).
- Explicit carve-out allowing documented cloud-hosting pass-through increases (60 days' notice).
- Offer a 12% discount in year 1 as consideration for the concessions.

Conditions:
- Legal to finalize the redline language exactly as Laura proposed (numeric cap language + termination window).
- Finance to confirm updated ARR/TCV impact and sign-off on discount schedule (Vivek to log concession in our pricing playbook).
- Procurement must execute PO and countersign by 2026-03-20 or the concessions expire.
- Sales to coordinate with CS for onboarding credits and to confirm SLOs before go-live.

Rishi — you have my approval to present the counter to Apex per these terms. Please copy me on the final.

Evelyn Hart
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood counter: Apex Health 3yr commitment — approved commercial package

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clarity and patience. Following internal review, Redwood can proceed with the following counter (executive-approved):

1) Term & Price-lock
- 3-year committed term.
- Price-lock on list prices for the first 12 months (no increases during months 1–12).

2) Uplift cap
- After month 12, annual price increases limited to the lesser of (i) 8% and (ii) CPI.

3) Carve-outs & notice
- Documented third-party cloud/hosting cost pass-throughs allowed with 60 days' notice.
- Customer receives at least 90 days' notice for other price changes. If an increase exceeds the stated cap, Customer may terminate within 30 days and receive a pro rata refund of prepaid fees.

4) Commercial consideration
- Redwood to offer a 12% discount in year 1 as consideration for the concessions.

5) Next steps
- Laura has attached the redlined SOW; please confirm legal review on your side.
- If acceptable, we'll send the final DocuSign for signature: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Sign/ABC-123-Apex
- This offer expires if we don't get a countersigned PO by 2026-03-20.

Attachment: redlines_ApexHealth.docx

Please let me know if you'd like us to adjust anything — Rishi and I are available to jump on a quick call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
